snippet.title: How I Won my First Game Jam | R&Dy Devlog #1
snippet.description:
Link to game:
https://phibian.itch.io/randy
JOIN THE DISCORD: https://discord.gg/8ZmpVrBkPq
SUPPORT ME ON PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/phibdev

I created a game for the 2022 Big Festive Game Jam called R&Dy and it ended up winning first place. This is the first video of a series where I show the entire process of creating it start to finish.

If you like the video and want to see the rest as they come out, feel free to subscribe!

Support me on Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/phibdev

Music Used
-------------------------
Original Music from R&Dy
Celeste OST: https://radicaldreamland.bandcamp.com/album/celeste-original-soundtrack
Eastward OST: https://joelcorelitz.bandcamp.com/album/eastward-original-soundtrack
